source: Zhang et al., The Same but Different, ICLR 2025, supplied PDF Figure 2 (page 5)
scope: All head IDs in Figure 2 are black/shared and therefore applicable to English. Functional labels are the paper's labels, not our independently validated assignments.
position_assumption: Output retention positions follow Wang/Easy-Transformer conventions: previous-token heads at S1+1; duplicate/induction heads at S2; inhibition/name-mover/negative heads at END. Exact BLOOM circuit extraction masks are not supplied in this paper.
